fsm_local_orders.exact_use: At a box node ord_t(x)=a1/4 and ord_t(z)=a2/4, with a1,a2 divisible by 4 and a1+a2 divisible by 8.

resolved_modular_fiber.exact_use: C2->X(4) is the residual local degree-2 cusp cover after the etale degree-4 X(8)->C2 quotient; on the resolution div(u)=2L+E and fixed V6 factor degrees are 105 and 81.

beauville_odd_contact.exact_use: For a normalized node branch with exceptional contact m, the Beauville pullback is ramified iff m is odd; any positive integer m admits the coarse minimal cusp choice a1=a2=4m.

local_base_change_adapter.setup: Let u be an X(4) cusp parameter, v a C2 cusp parameter with u=v^2, and t a local parameter on N with u=t^k*unit.
local_base_change_adapter.normalization_formula: For g=gcd(k,2), the normalization of v^2=t^k*unit has g points above t=0, each with ramification index k/g for the map to C2.
local_base_change_adapter.total_projection_ramification_at_the_cus: rho(k)=k-gcd(k,2), i.e. k-1 for odd k and k-2 for even k.
local_base_change_adapter.node_factor_orders: At a node branch, if m=I(Gamma,E) and ell_i=I(Gamma,L_i) for the relevant factor boundary strict transform, then k_i=m+2*ell_i by div(u_i)=2L_i+E.
local_base_change_adapter.node_parity: k_i congruent m mod 2 for both factors, agreeing with the Beauville odd-contact ramification criterion.
local_base_change_adapter.smooth_boundary_contribution: Away from nodes, k_i=2*ell_i and rho_i=2*ell_i-2; a transverse boundary hit ell_i=1 contributes zero projection ramification.

coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.node_partition_rule: For each exceptional total M_j choose q_j with q_j congruent M_j mod2, 0<=q_j<=M_j, sum q_j=Q; split M_j into q_j parts equal to 1 and (M_j-q_j)/2 parts equal to 2.
coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.existence_for_all_residual_Q: Starting from q_j=M_j mod2 (sum 26), increments q_j->q_j+2 have total capacity (266-26)/2=120, so every even Q from 26 through 266, in particular all 29 residual Q values, is reachable.
coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.node_cusp_choice: For every part m in {1,2}, take the coarse source-admissible a1=a2=4m. Then k_1=k_2=m, ell_1=ell_2=0 and rho_1=rho_2=0.
coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.smooth_boundary_choice: Realize each unit of each C.L boundary pairing by a distinct transverse smooth-boundary hit ell=1; then k=2 and rho=0.
coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.result: The exact class/contact ledgers admit a coarse local valuation realization with zero ramification over all six special cusps for both descended projections, for every one of the 29 Q-slack states.
coarse_zero_cusp_ramification_witness_fa.realizability_firewall: This is only a local/coarse valuation witness showing noncontradiction of the cusp adapter. It is not a global curve, section, or map realization.

projection_ramification_decomposition.assignment_scope: Numerical compatibility only; existence and common-source compatibility of such off-cusp ramification divisors are not proved.

decision.new_exact_pattern: Both projection ramification divisors split into explicitly controlled special-cusp contributions plus unresolved off-cusp/common-map contributions; the special-cusp contribution can be zero for every residual Q state at the present class/contact resolution.
decision.exact_blocker: Need member-level data or a theorem coupling the two off-cusp ramification divisors / local factor exponents for the same connected h=4 common-cover component. Class intersections and exceptional contact totals alone do not supply that compatibility.

cycle_exit.CYCLE_ACTIVE_RECEIVER: 29 h=4 Q-slack states with two degree-105/81 maps D->C2 and common connected-cover origin
cycle_exit.CYCLE_NEW_VIEW: Use the common h=4 cover to couple the two maps globally (torsor/correspondence/Rosati) rather than trying to force ramification at the six special cusps.
